epistle: St. Paul's First Letter to the Thessalonians 2:1-8
fast: Abstain from meat, fish, dairy, eggs, wine, olive oil

thought.quote: How will one who transgresses love toward his parents raise himself toward love for his enemies? Love for one's parents - this is the main and fundamental school of love. Without this school, one can go no further.
thought.author: St. Nicholai of Zhicha
